dialogues.jp:
図書室は、はたして本当に本を読むだけの場所
なのか。
dialogues.en:
I wonder whether the library really is a place to read books
at.
dialogues.text:
I wonder whether the library really is a place to read books
at.

dialogues.jp: 勉強をする場所？　いいや、違うな。
dialogues.en: A place for studying? Not really either.
dialogues.text: A place for studying? Not really either.

dialogues.jp: 寝るところだ！
dialogues.en: It's a place for sleeping!
dialogues.text: It's a place for sleeping!

dialogues.jp:
静かで、他の教室からも離れていて、なにげに
日当たりもよく……。
dialogues.en:
Quiet, far from the other classrooms, just the right amount
of sunlight...
dialogues.text:
Quiet, far from the other classrooms, just the right amount
of sunlight...

dialogues.jp: 完璧だ！
dialogues.en: It's perfect!
dialogues.text: It's perfect!

dialogues.jp: 「──グッナイ！」
dialogues.en: "---Good night!"
dialogues.text: "---Good night!"

dialogues.jp: さんさんと輝く太陽に、おやすみを告げる。
dialogues.en: I said to the brightly-shining sun, through the window.
dialogues.text: I said to the brightly-shining sun, through the window.

dialogues.jp: 睡眠には、レム睡眠とノンレム睡眠がある。
dialogues.en: There are two different types of sleep; REM, and non-REM.
dialogues.text: There are two different types of sleep; REM, and non-REM.

dialogues.jp:
だいたい９０分置きに入れ替わり、レム睡眠は
身体の眠り、ノンレム睡眠は脳の眠りと呼ばれ
ている。
dialogues.en:
Within 90 seconds of REM sleep, your entire body is put to
rest. However, unlike non-REM sleep, your brain stays
active.
dialogues.text:
Within 90 seconds of REM sleep, your entire body is put to
rest. However, unlike non-REM sleep, your brain stays
active.

dialogues.jp:
そして、レム睡眠中は、夢をよく見ると言われ
ている。
dialogues.en: It's during REM sleep that dreams can be recalled easily.
dialogues.text: It's during REM sleep that dreams can be recalled easily.

dialogues.jp:
眠った早々、夢を見る。自分の夢ならまだしも
他人の夢だ。
dialogues.en:
Thusly, during this sleep, I saw a dream. Not my own, but
that of someone else's.
dialogues.text:
Thusly, during this sleep, I saw a dream. Not my own, but
that of someone else's.

dialogues.jp:
楽しみにしていたドラマを見ようとテレビをつ
けたら画面の上に、
dialogues.en:
It's like expecting to see your favourite drama on TV, then
seeing the dreaded words,
dialogues.text:
It's like expecting to see your favourite drama on TV, then
seeing the dreaded words,

dialogues.jp:
“野球中継延長のため、ドラマ『ラッキーク
　ローバー』は、中継が終わり次第の放送に
　なります”
dialogues.en:
"Due to the extension of the baseball game broadcast, the
drama "Lucky Clover" will be delayed until the game is
finished."
dialogues.text:
"Due to the extension of the baseball game broadcast, the
drama "Lucky Clover" will be delayed until the game is
finished."

dialogues.jp: と出ているようなものだ。
dialogues.en: ...scroll across the top of the screen.
dialogues.text: ...scroll across the top of the screen.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、それでも試合自体が面白ければそれほど
気にはならないのだが。
dialogues.en:
Well, if the baseball game itself is entertaining, it's not
a problem either.
dialogues.text:
Well, if the baseball game itself is entertaining, it's not
a problem either.

dialogues.jp:
──桜の花びらの中をかき消えるような小さな
声が、響き渡る。
dialogues.en:
--A tiny voice emnated from the swirling sakura petals,
resounding around the place.
dialogues.text:
--A tiny voice emnated from the swirling sakura petals,
resounding around the place.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「花……、花が咲いた」
dialogues.en: "Flower... a flower is blooming."
dialogues.text: "Flower... a flower is blooming."

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ようやく咲いた。綺麗な花が」
dialogues.en: "It finally bloomed. It's a pretty flower."
dialogues.text: "It finally bloomed. It's a pretty flower."

dialogues.jp: ガラスのような繊細で透明なトーンのボイス。
dialogues.en: A voice as thin and delicate as glass.
dialogues.text: A voice as thin and delicate as glass.

dialogues.jp:
桜の花びらが彼女の感情を表わしているかのよ
うに、ゆっくりと舞い落ちる。
dialogues.en:
As if expressing the girl's feelings, the sakura petals
slowly drifted to the floor.
dialogues.text:
As if expressing the girl's feelings, the sakura petals
slowly drifted to the floor.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「これで私は……、もう寂しくない」
dialogues.en: "With this... I won't be alone anymore."
dialogues.text: "With this... I won't be alone anymore."

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「寂しくないと思う……」
dialogues.en: "I think I won't..."
dialogues.text: "I think I won't..."

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「たぶん、寂しくない……」
dialogues.en: "Probably, I won't..."
dialogues.text: "Probably, I won't..."

dialogues.jp:
画面を桜の花びらが覆いつくす。声も消え、桜
の木も。すべて。
dialogues.en:
The sakura petals then completely shrouded the screen. The
voice disappeared, as did the sakura tree. It all vanished.
dialogues.text:
The sakura petals then completely shrouded the screen. The
voice disappeared, as did the sakura tree. It all vanished.

dialogues.jp: そして、暗闇が辺りを包み込む。
dialogues.en: Darkness enveloped everyhting.
dialogues.text: Darkness enveloped everyhting.

dialogues.jp: 暗闇……。
dialogues.en: Darkness...
dialogues.text: Darkness...

dialogues.jp: 寂しい。
dialogues.en: Lonely.
dialogues.text: Lonely.

dialogues.jp: 寂しいな。
dialogues.en: So lonely.
dialogues.text: So lonely.

dialogues.jp: 卒業だもんな。
dialogues.en: Graduation's near.
dialogues.text: Graduation's near.

dialogues.jp: みんな、卒業したら、どうするんだろうな。
dialogues.en: What'd everyone do when they graduate...
dialogues.text: What'd everyone do when they graduate...

dialogues.jp: 寂しいな。
dialogues.en: So lonely.
dialogues.text: So lonely.

dialogues.jp: こんな暗闇じゃ、きっと寂しいね。
dialogues.en: In this darkness, it'd definitely be lonely.
dialogues.text: In this darkness, it'd definitely be lonely.

dialogues.jp: 「ん……あ。んん……、今何時だ？」
dialogues.en: "Mm... ah. Hmm... what time is it?"
dialogues.text: "Mm... ah. Hmm... what time is it?"

dialogues.jp:
目を覚まし、ヨダレの感触が残る顔を上げ、壁
にかかっている時計を見上げる。
dialogues.en:
Opening my eyes, and quickly wiping the drool off my mouth,
I checked the clock on the wall.
dialogues.text:
Opening my eyes, and quickly wiping the drool off my mouth,
I checked the clock on the wall.

dialogues.jp:
「なんだ、後１０分もあるじゃないか……。驚
　かせやがって……」
dialogues.en: "Huh, it's only been 10 minutes... felt like longer..."
dialogues.text: "Huh, it's only been 10 minutes... felt like longer..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は胸元を揺るめ、一息つく。
dialogues.en: The heaviness in my chest started to go away.
dialogues.text: The heaviness in my chest started to go away.

dialogues.jp:
もう一度寝ようかと思ったが、それはあまりに
も危険なので、やめておいた。
dialogues.en:
I could go to sleep again, but it semes like it'd
get...dangerous, somehow.
dialogues.text:
I could go to sleep again, but it semes like it'd
get...dangerous, somehow.

dialogues.jp:
ふと、机の端の方を見ると、俺と同じように寝
ているヤツがいた。
dialogues.en:
Looking at the other end of the desk, apparently there was
someone who was sleeping like I was.
dialogues.text:
Looking at the other end of the desk, apparently there was
someone who was sleeping like I was.

dialogues.jp: 「ありゃ、なんだ。月城じゃないか」
dialogues.en: "Whoa. It's Tsukishiro."
dialogues.text: "Whoa. It's Tsukishiro."

dialogues.jp:
それは、月城であり、頭の下に可愛らしく両手
を重ねて、無垢な寝顔で寝ていた。
dialogues.en:
She was cutely resting her head on her arms, folded across
the table. Her sleeping face exuded innocence and purity.
dialogues.text:
She was cutely resting her head on her arms, folded across
the table. Her sleeping face exuded innocence and purity.

dialogues.jp:
よく見ると、寝ているのは月城だけではなく、
他にも何人かがすやすやと寝息を立てていた。
dialogues.en:
Looking around more closely, it wasn't just Tsukishiro
sleeping here. Several others had the same idea.
dialogues.text:
Looking around more closely, it wasn't just Tsukishiro
sleeping here. Several others had the same idea.

dialogues.jp: よく見ると、萌先輩もいる。
dialogues.en: Even Moe-senpai was here.
dialogues.text: Even Moe-senpai was here.

dialogues.jp: ここはいつからレストルームになったんだ。
dialogues.en: Seems like this is the school's unofficial "rest room".
dialogues.text: Seems like this is the school's unofficial "rest room".

dialogues.jp:
まあ、春が近いからだな……。（まだ３月に入っ
たばかりだが）
dialogues.en:
Well, Spring is coming soon... (even though there's the rest
of March to go)
dialogues.text:
Well, Spring is coming soon... (even though there's the rest
of March to go)

dialogues.jp:
そろそろ休憩が終わる。せめて月城くらいは起
こしてやろう。
dialogues.en:
Lunch break is going to end soon. I should wake Tsukishiro
up now.
dialogues.text:
Lunch break is going to end soon. I should wake Tsukishiro
up now.

dialogues.jp: 他の連中は知ったこっちゃない。
dialogues.en: I don't know the others.
dialogues.text: I don't know the others.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩は、どうせ５秒後にすぐ寝てしまうだろ
うし。
dialogues.en:
And Moe-senpai would probably fall asleep again 5 seconds
after, anyway.
dialogues.text:
And Moe-senpai would probably fall asleep again 5 seconds
after, anyway.

dialogues.jp:
「月城、月城。起きろよ。そろそろ５時限目が
　始まるぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Tsukishiro, Tsukishiro, wake up. 5th period is going to
start soon."
dialogues.text:
"Tsukishiro, Tsukishiro, wake up. 5th period is going to
start soon."

dialogues.jp: その細い身体をゆさゆさと揺する。
dialogues.en: I gently shook her tiny frame, trying to wake her up.
dialogues.text: I gently shook her tiny frame, trying to wake her up.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、起きな」
dialogues.en: "Come on, up and at 'em."
dialogues.text: "Come on, up and at 'em."

dialogues.jp:
月城はゆっくりと身体を起こし、眠そうに目を
こする。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro slowly started moving her body, looking up at me
with sleepy eyes.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro slowly started moving her body, looking up at me
with sleepy eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉、先輩」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura, senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura, senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「こんなところで寝てると風邪引くぞ」
dialogues.en: "You'd catch a cold if you sleep here."
dialogues.text: "You'd catch a cold if you sleep here."

dialogues.jp: 月城が、寝ぼけまなこでこくんと頷いた。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro, still half-asleep, nodded at my chide.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro, still half-asleep, nodded at my chide.

dialogues.jp: ……わかってんのかな、ホントに。
dialogues.en: ...I wonder whether she really understands.
dialogues.text: ...I wonder whether she really understands.

dialogues.jp:
俺はまた眠ってそうな月城に、人形を持たせ、
もう一度声をかける。
dialogues.en:
She was still holding her doll, seeming like she wanted to
go back to sleep again. I called out to her to wake her up
again.
dialogues.text:
She was still holding her doll, seeming like she wanted to
go back to sleep again. I called out to her to wake her up
again.

dialogues.jp: 月城は、こくこくんと二回頷いた。
dialogues.en: This time, she nodded twice.
dialogues.text: This time, she nodded twice.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあな、二度寝はするなよ」
dialogues.en: "Later then, don't fall asleep again."
dialogues.text: "Later then, don't fall asleep again."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、なんとなく月城のことを気にしながら、
図書室を出たのだった。
dialogues.en: Still worried about Alice, I eventually left the library.
dialogues.text: Still worried about Alice, I eventually left the library.

dialogues.jp: ◆寂しくない◆
dialogues.en: ◆Won't Be Lonely◆
dialogues.text: ◆Won't Be Lonely◆

dialogues.jp: 図書室で寝ていると、不思議な夢を見た。
dialogues.en: Sleeping in the library, I saw a weird dream.
dialogues.text: Sleeping in the library, I saw a weird dream.

dialogues.jp:
例によって他人の夢だったが、寂しいとか寂し
くないとか、そんな内容の夢だった。
dialogues.en:
It was a girl's dream, about how she was lonely, and how she
won't be anymore.
dialogues.text:
It was a girl's dream, about how she was lonely, and how she
won't be anymore.

dialogues.jp:
目を覚ますと、俺だけではなく何人かがすやす
やと眠っており、その中には、月城も混ざって
いた。
dialogues.en:
When I woke up, I realized that not just me, but several
other people were all sleeping in the library. Among them
was Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text:
When I woke up, I realized that not just me, but several
other people were all sleeping in the library. Among them
was Tsukishiro.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、彼女が風邪を引かないよう起こしてやる
と、図書室を後にした。
dialogues.en:
I woke her up, not wanting her to catch a cold, then left
the library.
dialogues.text:
I woke her up, not wanting her to catch a cold, then left
the library.
